changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.sql: CREATE POLICY announcements_insert_admin ON club_announcements FOR INSERT WITH CHECK ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm JOIN player_profiles pp ON pp.id = cm.player_id WHERE cm.club_id = club_announcements.club_id AND pp.user_id = auth.uid() AND cm.status = 'active' AND cm.role IN ('OWNER', 'ADMIN', 'MODERATOR') ) AND author_player_id IN (SELECT id FROM player_profiles WHERE user_id = auth.uid()) );
changeSet.rollback: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS announcements_insert_admin ON club_announcements;

changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.sql: CREATE POLICY announcements_update_admin ON club_announcements FOR UPDATE USING ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm JOIN player_profiles pp ON pp.id = cm.player_id WHERE cm.club_id = club_announcements.club_id AND pp.user_id = auth.uid() AND cm.status = 'active' AND cm.role IN ('OWNER', 'ADMIN', 'MODERATOR') ) ) WITH CHECK ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm JOIN player_profiles pp ON pp.id = cm.player_id WHERE cm.club_id = club_announcements.club_id AND pp.user_id = auth.uid() AND cm.status = 'active' AND cm.role IN ('OWNER', 'ADMIN', 'MODERATOR') ) );
changeSet.rollback: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS announcements_update_admin ON club_announcements;

changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.sql: CREATE POLICY announcements_delete_admin ON club_announcements FOR DELETE USING ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM club_memberships cm JOIN player_profiles pp ON pp.id = cm.player_id WHERE cm.club_id = club_announcements.club_id AND pp.user_id = auth.uid() AND cm.status = 'active' AND cm.role IN ('OWNER', 'ADMIN') ) );
changeSet.rollback: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS announcements_delete_admin ON club_announcements;
